LanguageData.RimAIPortrait.Help.NovelAiV5WarningTitle: Warning: Major portrait features are unavailable in V5
LanguageData.RimAIPortrait.Help.NovelAiV5SpriteWarnin:
NovelAI V5 support in this mod is incomplete. Character Reference, Vibe Transfer, style folder images, and selected gallery references do not work. Generation fails if gallery references remain selected.
Base generation uses the pawn sprite for img2img. The result may no longer look like the same character. Use Tag Extractor or describe the character yourself. V5 Curated expressions use V4.5 Curated inpainting. Check these limitations before using V5.
